205.name: Fade early blowout winner
205.rule: Won by 15+ last game and favored, first 3 weeks → bet against them

206.name: Back the winless team
206.rule: Team is 0-3 or worse, first 3 weeks → bet them

207.name: Fade the unbeaten favorite
207.rule: Team is 3-0 or better and favored, first 3 weeks → bet against them

208.name: Early-season over
208.rule: Every game in the first 2 weeks → over. Last 4 seasons 226-181 (55.5%) vs the close, +1.6 to +2.5 pts a game each year; 2020-21 and 2021-22 went the other way (scoring fell)

301.name: Personnel side, every game
301.rule: Whichever side the personnel line likes, every game, any gap. Graded so the record can be split by gap size, day-to-day status and blind spots.

302.name: Fade the team missing 2+ rotation players
302.rule: A team is missing 2+ rotation players (20+ mpg), more than its opponent, at least one of them played its last game → bet the opponent. 2 seasons vs the close: 249-199 (55.6%), both seasons 55-56% (engine/measure_cluster.py). Tracking only until it earns real money.

303.name: Fade the team missing 2+ FRESH rotation players
303.rule: Like X2, but at least 2 of the missing rotation players played the team's last game (fresh news; long absences are already priced). 2 seasons vs the close: 142-108 (56.8%; 58.1% / 55.6%), at the open 147-103 (engine/measure_cluster.py, Nov 11). Tracking only.

304.name: Fade the team missing 2+ rotation players at different positions
304.rule: Like X2 (1+ fresh), and the missing players are all at different positions (guard / wing / big): the team can't just slide the next man in. 2 seasons vs the close: 139-103 (57.4%; 59.5% / 55.0%), at the open 142-101 (engine/measure_cluster.py, Nov 11). Tracking only.

305.name: Back the team that won its last game by 25+
305.rule: The market expects a letdown after a blowout win; it doesn't come. 2 seasons: 169-134 at the open, 159-122 at the close, both seasons (engine/measure_ideas.py, Nov 11). Tracking only.

306.name: Fade the team coming off an overtime game (early line)
306.rule: Its last game went to overtime: bet the opponent at the FIRST line. 2 seasons: 117-90 at the open, only 105-95 at the close (engine/measure_ideas.py, Nov 11). Tracking only.

307.name: Both teams shooting below their shot quality: over
307.rule: Both teams' field-goal points ran 2+ a game below what their shots were worth (shot locations, last 5 games). 2 seasons: 121-102 at the open, 114-98 at the close (engine/measure_ideas.py). Tracking only.

308.name: Follow a 2+ point line move
308.rule: The spread moved 2+ points from the first line we saw: bet the side it moved toward, at the price after the move. 2 seasons at the close: 279-223 (55.6%), both seasons (engine/measure_ideas2.py). Tracking only.

309.name: Home team with 2+ more days of rest
309.rule: Home team rested 2+ more days than the visitor -> home. 2 seasons: 66-41 at the open, 63-43 at the close (engine/measure_ideas2.py). Tracking only.
